{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Romania|Romanian Cuisine]]

'''Mititei''' or '''mici''' (grilled skinless sausages) is a typical Romanian dish. Usually in Romania you can find the prepared meat mixture in most food shops, and you only have to cook them.

==Ingredients==
*Minced [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]] meat (or [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]]/beef-pork combination)
*Minced [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
*[[Cookbook:Pepper|White pepper]]
*[[Cookbook:Paprika|Paprika]]

==Procedure==
#Combine all ingredients to form a paste.
#Shape meat mixture by hand into 7–8 x 2–2.5 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]] (3 x 1 [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]]) sausage shapes. Each should be about 50 [[Cookbook:g|grams]].
#[[Cookbook:Grilling|Grill]] the sausages until cooked through. Do not let them dry out.
#Serve with [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]], [[Cookbook:Mustard|mustard]], and [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]].

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* If grilling is not possible, you can [[Cookbook:Frying|fry]] the sausages in a skillet with some [[Cookbook:Lard|lard]]. Do not use oil.
